tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dang sa skya pa'i chos skyong gzhan rnams la lhan cig tu mchod gtor 'bul tshul gyi yi ge bzhugs// 'dir dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud/ phur bsrung sogs la gtor bsngo dang thugs dam bskang ba'i phyag len gyi bsgrigs rim ngo mtshar can shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas deng sang gi bar du yang ma nyams par dar rgyas su 'dug pa 'di rnams dang lhan cig tu dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la gtor bsngo dang thugs dam bskang bar 'dod na/ bdag bskyed gang rigs kyi rjes su kye rdor gtor bsngo nas bzung gur mgon lcam dral la gtor ma phul nas 'phrin bcol grub pa yan dkyus bzhin byas la/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar rlung nag ces pa nas/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo bskyed bstim gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol grub pa yan gtor chog bzhin byas la/ de nas zhal bzhi pa nas bzung gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar dang / der rjes 'khon bcug sbyang ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas yi ge brgya pa dang / de wa pi tsu nas brtsams lcam dral gnyis kyi sngags nam rdzogs grangs ji ltar rigs pa skabs thob kyi dmigs pa dang bcas bzlas tshar ba dang / dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i sngags dmigs pa dang bcas gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs rjes zhal bzhi pa dang phur bsrung gi sngags kyi bar dang / de nas 'phrin bcol/ bshags pa/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs sogs nas bzung ste/ gur lcam dral gyi bskang gso rgyas bsdus skabs su gang babs grub rjes/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i spyan 'dren/ bskang ba rgyas bsdus bshags pa gnyis rnams rgya cher sogs gang dgos byas la/ de rjes nged rang gis brtsams pa'i dmag zor rgyal mo'i bstod gsar dbyangs gang 'os dang bcas grub mtshams/ zhal bzhi pa/ las mkhan pu tra lcam sring / dkar bdud sogs kyi bskang gso rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang /

spyi bskang sku dang gsung thugs ma sogs dkyus bzhin byas la/ de nas 'phrin bcol mgon po'i bskang gso gang byas kyi 'phrin bcol/ de'i mjug tu dmag zor rgyal mo'i bskang gso 'phrin bcol rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang / de bzhin du mgon po'i bzlog pa'i rjes su bzlog pa bya'o/ /bstod pa ni gur lcam dral gyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs shig grub mtshams su/ bhyoḥrakmo sogs sngags dbyangs dang / de nas dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bskang dpe'i nang du 'byung ba ltar gyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang 'os dang / de nas zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ las mkhan/ dkar bdud/ phur bsrung rnams kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang 'os dkyus bzhin dang / lha yi tshogs rnams sogs dang / rdo rje'i glu/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams grub mtshams tshogs 'khor yod na bdag bskyed gang byas kyi cho gas tshogs byin rlabs bya zhing / spyi bstab kyi skabs su gur mgon lcam dral/ zhal bzhi pa sogs kyi spyi bstab dkyus ma'i rjes su dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i spyi bstab bya'o/ /de nas 'phrin bcol 'di la dbyangs byas tshe 'phrin bcol dang bkra shis thun mong du 'gro ba yin/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma dang / dpal mgon mahā kā la sogs kyi bkra shis grub rjes mjug chog dkyus bzhin bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i phyag len gyi rim pa 'di ni gsar du byas pa'i rtog bzo rig bcos ma yin gyi/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin te/ sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed gdams pa rin chen 'bar bar blta bar gyis shig dang / log rtog gi gti sel bar 'gyur te/ yi ge 'di'i nang bzhin gyi phyag len ma 'phyugs pa'i sgo nas dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo la rgyun dang dus kyi mchod gtor 'bul ba la brtson par bgyis na lha mo 'di gzhan las 'phrin las myur bar grags pas/

gang bcol ba'i las rnams 'bad med du 'grub par nges so/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dang sa skya pa'i chos skyong gzhan rnams lhan cig tu mchod gtor 'bul ba'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi drung du dpal ldan lha mo 'di'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis rang gi 'dod don 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dpal ldan lha mo 'di la dus kyi gtor ma chag med du 'bul ba la bsams nas bris pa 'dis don gnyer can rnams la phan par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// //ka lya na wardhantu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dmag zor rgyal mo dang sa skya pa'i chos skyong gzhan rnams la lhan cig tu mchod gtor 'bul tshul gyi yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
